purpose: Teach: どん底/城壁/順応/蒸発/牽制/発着/老齢/海戦

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、どん底からの復活劇を社員に示せ
lines.en: I want to show our people that we can rise from rock bottom. Make it happen.
lines.style: Direct, clipped attack. Measured pace with weight behind each phrase. The tone of someone who's already won once before. No room for doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報セキュリティを城壁の如く強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll fortify our information security like a fortress wall.
lines.style: Measured and earnest. Takes the directive seriously — slightly faster pace to show readiness. A small lift at the end, confirming agreement without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外文化に順応できる人材を採用しろ
lines.en: We need to hire people who can adapt to different cultures. Make sure it happens.
lines.style: Firm, expectant. Slight emphasis on 'adapt'—this matters. Steady tempo. The impatience of someone waiting to see execution, not just agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員が突然蒸発する事のないよう面談を増やします
lines.en: Yes. We'll increase check-ins with staff so no one just disappears on us.
lines.style: Reassuring but practical. Acknowledges the problem without dwelling on it. Calm delivery, slightly faster to show he's already thinking through implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合を牽制する新製品を出せ
lines.en: We need a new product that makes competitors think twice before moving.
lines.style: Sharp, confident opening on 'need.' Slight pause after 'product' — letting the weight settle. Cool certainty. The tone of someone outlining strategy, not asking for permission.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出張の発着スケジュールを最適化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll optimize our travel schedules to hit them faster.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Leaner delivery than before — no hesitation. Shows he's already mapped the path. Slight forward momentum in the pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、老齢社員の活躍の場を作れ
lines.en: We need to create real opportunities for our older staff. Let them show what they can do.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate than the previous directives. Weight on 'real' and 'show'—this is personal conviction, not just business. Quiet dignity in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海戦級の本気で競合に挑みます
lines.en: Yes. We're going to face our competitors with everything we have.
lines.style: Firm, energized closing statement. Breath of determination underneath. Slightly higher in register — matching the gravity of the final moment. A small pause before the last phrase for impact.
